plain: A man named Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, presented as a former senior CIA officer, told podcast host Jesse Michels about his daughter's first visit to the Church of the Holy Sepulchre in Jerusalem, a church tied to the death of Jesus. He says that as she looked at what is shown as Jesus's cross, she asked him a question that stayed with him. No date is given.
